_comment: velocity m/s, gravity = projectile gravity scale. Optional: acceleration (m/s^2, negative = slows down) + acceleration_time (s), arc low/high, aim overlay/elevation, unit deg/mil, angle_offset, min_distance, elevation_limits [min,max], category, note, note_ru, mod. Sources: in-game values from the official Squad wiki (squad.fandom.com) and SquadCalc (github.com/sh4rkman/SquadCalc).
